{{Conjecture|legends}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''bounty hunter''' once led an effort to crack down load shipment at [[Botha Ammunitions Corporation]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]], which the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] considered a possible equipment leak.<ref name="GR" />

In reality, Bothamco and [[Reclamation Services, Inc.]] had a deal to recycle "defective" [[Blaster power pack/Legends|blaster ammo packs]] and [[blaster gas/Legends|gas]] canisters, which they [[smuggler/Legends|smuggled]] to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref>''[[Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide]]''</ref>

One [[Local day/Legends|day]], a hired freighter went through the search procedures, and although they had nothing to worry about, they inadvertently [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggled]] [[Blaster power pack/Legends|blaster power packs]] and [[Blaster gas/Legends|blaster gas]] canisters out of Bothamco, disguised as recyclables. The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] dispatched several [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] to follow them to the [[Kothlis Starport]], tried to break into the ship and search the cargo bay for the packs and canisters; the freighter crew (who were Rebel agents) fended them off until the RSI arrived to collect the cargo.<ref name="GR" />

The bounty hunter, accompanied by mercenaries, attacked the Rebels as they were returning to their freighter from a meeting with [[Ukert]] (who lied that the bounty hunter was only an old rival of his). The [[Havocs]] joined the fight. The Rebel freighter took off to the [[Kothlis' second moon]] where the bounty hunter followed them. He found that the [[moon/Legends|moon]] was home to a [[Kothlis shadowport|secret shadowport]], where the Rebels dropped the recyclables in a spare parts bay. They tried to make sure that the bounty hunter wouldn't leave alive to expose the operation.<ref name="GR">''{{WEGCite|story=Garbage Run|book=Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide}}''</ref>
